Name: Rustboro - Farm and More
Author: recxie
Description:
Hi everyone,
This is my very first mod, inspired by a little bit of the style of Rustboro City from Pokémon Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald.

Installation:
1. Download & Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6183]Train Station[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2905]Bus Locations[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins[/url] ([b]OPTIONAL [/b]if you want to put mini fridge and bed),
2. Download [b]rustboro_v1.zip
[/b]3. Extract [b]rustboro_v1.zip[/b] in your Stardew [b]Mod[/b] folder.

To Uninstall this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder.

Notes:
1. To access this map, please use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2905]Bus Locations [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6183]Train Station[/url] mod (cost 500g).
2. This map ticket machine will always return the player to the [b]Railroad Train Station[/b].
3. To place [b]mini fridge[/b] and [b]bed [/b]inside the building, please use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins (EMP)[/url].
4. The Joja's vending machine sells seeds from any seasons (there might be seeds that not listed). 
5. If you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia's More Crops[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]PPJA's Fruits and Veggies[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671]PPJA's More Trees[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1721]PPJA's Fresh Meat[/url]: you can use [b]content(vendingSells_cornucopia_and_ppja).json [/b]file as your [b]content.json[/b] by renaming/replacing it (please backup the original [b]content.json[/b] file before replacing).

Lastly, this map might not be the most aesthetically pleasing map and contains few bugs, but I hope you'll find it enjoyable and I'll also try make some updates in the future. 
Any modifications and re-upload to your own Nexus account are welcome as well.

Sincerely,
recxie.
